summary: Identiv, Inc. entered into a Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its specialty IoT business to Trackonomy Systems, Inc. for $50 million in Series C Preferred Stock ($20.07/share) plus assumption of certain liabilities. The sale includes substantially all operating assets and shares of Identiv (Thailand) Co., Ltd., with $25 million cash transferred subject to working capital adjustments. Closing requires stockholder approval from both parties, no enjoining orders, and a charter amendment for Series C Preferred shares. Watch for stockholder vote timing and potential regulatory risks.
